title: House clears affordability bill to lower housing costs, sending it to Trump's desk for approval: Here's what we know
summary: The US House cleared a massive housing affordability bill on Tuesday (local time) aimed at boosting the supply of homes and cracking down on large investors buying up houses. The bill received 358-32 votes in favour and has now gone to Trump for approval
